initialIcon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one finished square app icon for the Android strategy game "Lamb and Tiger"; no lettering.
Reference: the attached image is ONLY a character identity and palette reference: the approved lamb and tiger pieces used inside this game. Create a cohesive new brand emblem from these characters, not a sprite sheet.
Audience: ages 10+ and adults equally. Calm, clever, friendly, premium tabletop game, not preschool, not an aggressive esports mascot.
Composition: a beautifully balanced close pairing of two recognizable heads, lamb lower left and tiger upper right, gently overlapping into one compact diagonal silhouette. Give both equal visual importance and keep both complete faces clearly visible. Ivory scalloped wool and short floppy ears on lamb, warm amber orange round ears and three strong forehead stripes on tiger. Preserve the reference's simple friendly face anatomy, dark teal eyes and outlines. Refine into exceptionally clean flat vector-like curves. Two characters, one memorable mark.
Background: SOLID deep teal #246657 filling the ENTIRE square to all four edges. No drawn outer rounded-square boundary; OS will mask it later. Emblem centered and surrounded by generous teal padding, contained within approximately the central 66 percent of the square so round crops preserve all ears. The emblem itself should be boldly legible at tiny size.
Colors: teal #246657, dark evergreen #103C35, warm ivory #F7F3EA, amber #EBA23B, a small sage accent for lamb face. Flat color, crisp silhouettes, excellent separation from background.
Avoid: words, initials, letters, badges, decorative borders, extra symbols, board diagram, triangular pieces, crowns, stars, sparkles, gradients, textures, 3D bevels, lighting effects, drop shadows, emoji look, angry teeth, oversize baby eyes, extra animals. Render ONLY the single final app icon, square 1024x1024 or larger.

logo:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished transparent-background horizontal brand logo for the Android strategy game "Lamb and Tiger".
The provided image is the approved new brand emblem: use the SAME overlapping ivory lamb head and amber tiger head, exact friendly face identities, same dark evergreen outlines, composition and colors. Extract and reproduce that paired-head emblem WITHOUT its teal background. Do not put the emblem in a tile or badge.
Layout: on the left, the paired-head emblem, compact and beautifully balanced. On the right, a distinctive professionally typeset wordmark on two lines: line 1 "Lamb and", line 2 "Tiger". Lamb and Tiger are equally prominent, while "and" is smaller and lighter. Text color dark evergreen #103C35. The complete verbatim name is "Lamb and Tiger". No other text. Modern rounded humanist sans lettering, confident generous forms, crisp optical kerning, mature enough for adults, warm for ages 10+. Not bubbly preschool lettering and not an esports font. Align the wordmark block optically with the emblem; purposeful balanced spacing, plenty of clear space.
Style: flat vector-like brand identity, clean smooth edges, ivory wool #F7F3EA, sage lamb face, amber tiger #EBA23B, dark evergreen outlines. No textures, gradients, bevels, drop shadows, board diagrams or decorative additions.
Output only ONE horizontal logo, around 2.5:1 aspect ratio, on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. No presentation board or mockup.
